name: new-game-to-reactor-entrance
description: #74 Tier 2 acceptance, first link of the chain: from the title snapshot (boot point "title", T = 1250), New Game, then through the opening movie to the first controllable field, judged only by a game-agnostic check: a still, non-blank picture for 5 s while Circle is pressed every second (segments title-to-new-game and opening-to-reactor-entrance). still_wait is the frames that wait took (0 on a timeout); frames is the script's length, so the still picture was reached at frame T + frames. The end state is kept in memory as the snapshot "reactor-entrance" for the next scenario in this run. match: the same script, played again from the title snapshot in a new core instance, ends in the same state (main RAM and picture, compared by hash inside the sandbox, reported only as 1/0). No FF7 address is used or claimed.
